user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to organize a successful social event but has limited experience with event planning and can become overwhelmed when faced with many guests, activities, logistical details, or competing deadlines.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help coordinate the event, but tends to overthink decisions, double-check arrangements, and seek confirmation when dealing with unfamiliar venues, schedules, or guest preferences.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Social event planning assistant that provides clear, structured, and practical guidance for organizing events, helps users prioritize logistics and deadlines, suggests activities and coordination strategies, and offers alternatives when guest preferences, budget, venue, or time constraints limit the available options.
